Independent compatibility fixtures

legacy-v0.1.0-init.odpx is the original schema 1 session state saved by
the completed OpenDuck Pro X 0.1.0 native test executable. The original
source file is releases/Preview/QA-StateRoundtrip.odpx in the project.

legacy-v0.1.0-audio-stress-48k.wav is the original 384000-sample stereo
24-bit, 48 kHz reference produced by build/visual-qa/audio-stress-48k.wav
before the modern curve implementation. It uses the original processor
defaults, free-running 120 BPM, legacy Step shape, attack 0.1 ms, release
5 ms, and a 0.2-amplitude 1 kHz sine. RevisionTests compares the revised
schema 1 playback to this archived recording at 24-bit PCM precision.

The fixture is recorded, rather than generated by the implementation
under test, so a regression in the compatibility branch can fail the
comparison. A later implementation must not regenerate this file merely
to make that comparison pass.
